title: Matam e hussain
body:
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Ya Hussain.....Ya Hussain
Maqsad e Hayat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain...×2
1) Rashm na samaj isey, hai ye teri Bandagi
Gar samaj mai aagaya, Toh yahi hai Zindagi
Ishq ki salaat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Maqsad e Hayat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain...×2
2) Jisko mil gayi Dua, Sayyeda Batool ki
Vo gum e Hussain mai, kar raha hai Naukri
Din ho ya ke Raat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Maqsad e Hayat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain...×2
3) Har gum o ki ye dawa, har maraz ki ye shifa
Ek wird e Ya Ali, Ek khaak e Karbala
Radd'e Mushkilaat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Maqsad e Hayat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain...×2
4) FikrE rozgaar kya, hu Dua e Sayyeda
Mai sada bana rahu, Khaak e paa e Bawafa
Meri Qayenaat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Maqsad e Hayat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain...×2
5) Hasr ke hungaam se Aye Raza tu Darr nahi
Hath tere saath hai, kya tuje khabar nahi
Kar pool e sirat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Maqsad e Hayat - Matam e Hussain
Kashti e Najat - Matame Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain...×2
